purpose: Define read-only external/remote DWH projection semantics that hide mutators rather than merely denying them after exposing a writable interface.

topics.name: DWH Remote Read-Only Boundary
topics.purpose: Define read-only external/remote DWH projection semantics that hide mutators rather than merely denying them after exposing a writable interface.

semantics.readonly_rule: Read-only remote projection exposes no mutating operations.
semantics.interface_rule: Mutators are absent/hidden from the projected interface where the boundary is read-only.
semantics.policy_rule: A separate explicit writable remote contract/policy is required to expose mutation.
semantics.ac_rule: Remote AccessCore authorization still applies to reads and any separately permitted writes.
semantics.schema_rule: Read-only projection retains the same schema/identity provenance as its source.
semantics.failure_rule: Attempted undeclared mutation hard-fails and cannot fall through to raw transport/EXT operation.
semantics.transport_rule: Transport capability to send data does not imply writable semantic interface.

invariants.rule: DWH applies data-boundary policy at the origin and target independently; remote addressing, transport reachability and external registration never substitute for AccessCore authorization.

hard_gates.condition: read-only interface exposes mutators as normal operations
transport send capability treated as write authority
raw EXT mutation bypasses DWH read-only boundary

references.purpose: Read-only projection applies after governed remote resolution.

prose.summary: Define read-only external/remote DWH projection semantics that hide mutators rather than merely denying them after exposing a writable interface.
